name: 🍕 Pepperoni Pizza Pasta Bake
tagline: Everything good about pizza, baked into a bubbly pan of Rao's fusilli.

items.name: Salt for the pasta water, olive oil

steps.text: Oven to 400°F. Boil a big pot of well-salted water.
Cook the fusilli 2 minutes less than the box says (it finishes in the oven). Save ½ cup pasta water, then drain.
Back in the pot, stir the pasta with the marinara, the pasta water, oregano, garlic powder, half the parmesan and 1 cup mozzarella.
Pour into a 9×13 dish. Top with the rest of the mozzarella.
Lay the pepperoni over the top and finish with parmesan.
Bake until bubbling and the pepperoni curls and crisps.

kid_jobs.job: Stir the sauce and cheese into the pasta
Spread the cheese over the top
Make a pepperoni pattern on top
Set a timer for the pasta and the bake

chef_tip: Underboil the pasta by 2 minutes and add a splash of pasta water. The noodles soak up sauce in the oven instead of turning mushy and dry.
make_ahead: Assemble up to a day ahead, cover and refrigerate. Bake 30 minutes covered, 10 uncovered.
leftovers: Reheats beautifully: microwave with a splash of water, or 15 minutes at 350°F.
swaps: Add sliced mini sweet peppers or mushrooms
serve_with: Garlic toast and a spring-mix salad
heads_up: Water on to boil and oven to 400°F.

game_plan.what: Oven to 400°F. Big pot of salted water on.
Fusilli in for 2 minutes less than the box.
Drain; stir in sauce, cheese and pasta water.
Kids layer mozzarella and pepperoni in the dish.
Bake until bubbling and the pepperoni curls.
